text:
max: Heads-up — planning a narrow canary for the cache+batch toggle `ff/cache_batch_v3` tomorrow 09:00 PT. Want to align on scope and rollback plan.
alyssa: +1, what audience are we targeting for the canary?
max: Targeting 5% traffic but only for requests routed to the non-critical ‘assist-lite’ model and only in us-west-2. No embeddings or admin routes.
priya: Sounds good. Can we pin concurrency to avoid burst differences? Suggest `concurrency_limit=8` for the canary nodes.
leo: Also add KV-prefetch disabled for the canary to isolate the batching change. We'll be toggling two flags: `ff/cache_batch_v3` and `ff/kv_prefetch_v2` (prefetch off for canary).
sara: For metrics, please capture p50/p95 latency, token/sec, GPU util, and HTTP 5xx. I'll create an ad-hoc dashboard.
jamal: Add cost metric — tokens per request delta. If unit cost increases >10% we abort.
max: Plan: 09:00 enable flags for 5% canary in us-west-2, run synthetic perf test for 15m, then 45m steady-state observation window. If all green, ramp to 20% and expand audience to ‘assist-standard’ after manual ok.
alyssa: Agreed. What are exact kill conditions? We should be explicit.
priya: My proposed kill conditions: 1) p95 latency increase >30% vs baseline for >5m, 2) error rate (4xx/5xx) increase >0.5% absolute, 3) GPU OOM or mem pressure events, 4) cost delta >10%.
leo: Add: cache hit rate drops by >15% vs baseline (that indicates mis-prefetch behavior).
sara: I'll set alerts for those thresholds and wire to #eng-oncall and PagerDuty.
max: Rollback procedure: 1) flip `ff/cache_batch_v3 = false` for canary audience, 2) flip `ff/kv_prefetch_v2` back to on, 3) scale canary group down, 4) postmortem in #eng-infra. Can someone own the rollback?
oncall-bot: @oncall scheduled for 09:00 PT window: incident channel watch enabled.
jamal: I'll own rollback and run initial remediation steps. Make me primary.
priya: Who runs the synthetic perf job? I can prepare a k6 script and a small runner.
max: Priya please — push script to `infra/perf/canary-cachebatch/k6` and paste command here.
priya: Will do. Example run command: `k6 run --vus 50 --duration 15m scripts/cachebatch_canary.js --tag audience=canary`
alyssa: Add a smoke test post-enable that validates token stream correctness. We had one header encoding regression last time.
leo: Good call — smoke test: 10 requests through the canary gateway, assert model output length and no repeated tokens, check KV access logs.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks: deployment artifacts built, infra templates validated, feature flag `ff/cache_batch_v3` exists in LaunchDarkly, canary group config: 5% rollouts available.
sara: Linking dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/CacheBatch/canary-overview — I'll add panels for p95, 5xx, cost/delta, cache-hit.
max: Communication: I'll post status in #eng-infra every 15m during the window and ping @sara for alerts. Also notify product that canary is limited scope.
alyssa: Quick ask — are there any dependent toggles (e.g., request-level routing overrides) that will interfere?
leo: There's a routing override flagged `ff/route_force_local` that could send traffic to local dev nodes — make sure it's false for the canary session. I'll check and lock it.
jamal: After a successful ramp to 20% we should schedule a follow-up run targeting 50% next week in a dedicated maintenance window.
priya: Perf script pushed to repo and linked in PR 4821. CI job `canary-smoke` will run on flag enable.
sara: I added alert playbook steps in the dashboard notes, including exact Grafana panels and runbook links.
max: OK all — summary: 09:00 PT tomorrow, 5% canary in us-west-2 for assist-lite, concurrency limit 8, KV-prefetch off, 15m synthetic + 45m observation, kill conditions listed, jamal owns rollback. If green -> manual ramp to 20%.
alyssa: :thumbsup: I'll be on watch at 09:00.
jamal: I'll be on-call for rollback. Ping me in-thread if anything spikes.
priya: I'll trigger the k6 job at 09:05 once flag flips.
leo: I'll validate routing overrides and lock `ff/route_force_local=false`.
sara: Alerts set, dashboard ready. Will ping if thresholds hit.
deploy-bot: Canary enablement scheduled at 1805004800 (automated window).
max: Thanks team — if no objections I'll flip the rollout to scheduled. Post any last-minute concerns here.
alyssa: No objections from me.
max: Done — scheduling now. Will post live updates tomorrow.
